messages:
Jamal R: Heads up — prepping release notes + internal blurb for tomorrow's rollout. Draft below, please quick review by EOD. Planning to pin runtime image `redwood/runtime:v2.3.1` for the canary, rollback plan is standard. @Lars H can you confirm the rollback window?

Sophia P: skimmed — looks good. A couple wording nits: change 'minor perf improvements' -> 'latency & throughput improvements' and call out the opt-in cache-change.

Jamal R: good call. updated snippet below. also added the canary timing and fallback policy.

Anna C: for internal announcement subject how about: "Upcoming: Inference Release (v2.3.1) — Canary 10:00 UTC" ? short + actionable.

Lars H: rollback window is fine. Suggest we keep a pinned fallback to `redwood/runtime:v2.3.0` for 2 hours after canary starts. Ops will monitor metrics and manually trigger fallback if 95th tail latency regresses > 25%.

Jamal R: perfect. will include that. Ops oncall: @Lars H (primary), @Sophia P (secondary).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled — canary at 2026-03-21T10:00:00Z on traffic: 5%. Notifying channels: #eng-oncall, #prod-alerts.

Sophia P: one more copy tweak: under 'breaking changes' we should explicitly state there are none for API surface. prevents tickets.

Jamal R: done. final draft below (copy to paste to internal announce):

```
Release: Inference Runtime v2.3.1 (canary)
When: 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC (canary -> 5% traffic)
Pin: redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 (canary) 
Fallback: redwood/runtime:v2.3.0 for 2h post-canary
Monitoring: 95th latency, error-rate, token-throttle metrics (Ops dashboard)
Notes: latency & throughput improvements for long-context workloads; optional prefix KV cache behavior improved (no API changes).
Breaking changes: none to public API.
Rollback criteria: 95th latency > +25% vs baseline OR error-rate > 1% absolute increase for sustained 5m.
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/wiki/release-123
```

Anna C: looks great — i'll slot the internal announcement for 09:45 UTC with that copy and add a short 'what to expect' TL;DR.

Lars H: Ops will be standing by at canary start. i'll post a quick status update 10 and 20 minutes in.

Jamal R: thanks all — if no objections by EOD i'll publish and pin the release image. :thumbsup:

Sophia P: :thumbsup: no objections from product.

Anna C: :raised_hands: good to go from comms.

deploy-bot: Canary started — redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 on 5% traffic (2026-03-21T10:00:00Z).
